The present application under Section 482 of the CrPC seeks following prayer:-
"In view of the facts and circumstances narrated herein above the applicant most respectfully prays before this Honble Court to kindly set aside the conviction order dated 08.06.2023 passed in F.I.R. No. 120/2016, Registered with P.S. Okhla, New Delhi, till the disposal or accompanying Appeal and Pass such further orders deem fit and proper in the interest of Justice."
2. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the appellant seeks leave to withdraw the present application at this stage.

3. Leave granted.
4. The present application is dismissed as withdrawn and disposed of accordingly.
CRL.A. 780/2023 & CRL.M.A. 25312/2023 (Exemption)
5. The present appeal under Section 374(2) of the CrPC challenges the judgment of conviction dated 08.06.2023, passed by Ms. Prabhdeep Kaur,
